sources.inspection: Read original PDF text with pdftotext -layout. Model/token allocation is an empirical question under a chosen compute constraint; over 400 runs and multiple training horizons underlie the fitted laws. Its infinite-data/subepoch condition differs from the repeated tiny corpus. Appendix F supplies 2-FLOP multiply-accumulate convention and separate dense/attention contributions.
